units.title: SG-2.5 · Mocked-dependency unit tests for the manifest loader
Act: Confirm loader reads fs only through node:fs named imports
Act: Confirm checkAssetRefs is pure and exported for chained tests
Verify: Mocked-fs loader unit tests for valid, invalid and missing assets

tests.name: loadManifestFile with mocked fs > loads successfully when the manifest is valid and the asset file exists
tests.title: loads successfully when the manifest is valid and the asset file exists
tests.scenario: Given a valid manifest JSON string and existsSync true, When loaded, Then ok is true with the parsed asset

tests.name: loadManifestFile with mocked fs > fails with a path naming the dimension when a dimension is zero
tests.title: fails with a path naming the dimension when a dimension is zero
tests.scenario: Given a manifest with width 0, When loaded, Then ok is false and the error path is assets.0.dimensions.width

tests.name: loadManifestFile with mocked fs > reports the manifest as unreadable when readFileSync throws
tests.title: reports the manifest as unreadable when readFileSync throws
tests.scenario: Given readFileSync throws, When loaded, Then it returns error path 'manifest' without throwing

tests.name: loadManifestFile with mocked fs > reports a missing asset file when existsSync returns false
tests.title: reports a missing asset file when existsSync returns false
tests.scenario: Given a valid manifest and existsSync false, When loaded, Then the error is 'missing asset file: a.svg' at assets.0.path

tests.name: loadManifestWithFallback with mocked fs > keeps the present asset and reports the absent one as missing
tests.title: keeps the present asset and reports the absent one as missing
tests.scenario: Given two assets where existsSync is true only for a.svg, When loaded with fallback, Then missing has length 1 and manifest.assets has length 1

tests.name: loadManifestWithFallback with mocked fs > falls back to an empty manifest when the manifest is schema-invalid
tests.title: falls back to an empty manifest when the manifest is schema-invalid
tests.scenario: Given a manifest with version 2, When loaded with fallback, Then the manifest is empty, errors are non-empty, and fallbackAssetId equals FALLBACK_ASSET_ID

tests.name: loadManifestWithFallback with mocked fs > falls back to an empty manifest with one error when readFileSync throws
tests.title: falls back to an empty manifest with one error when readFileSync throws
tests.scenario: Given readFileSync throws, When loaded with fallback, Then the manifest is empty, exactly one error is returned, and no real file is read

units.title: Verify: Mocked-fs dangling reference unit tests

tests.name: new: dangling refs after fallback load
tests.title: reports one issue per dangling ref, naming both the missing asset b and the unknown ghost
tests.scenario: Given a manifest with assets 'a' and 'b' where b's file is missing; When loaded with fallback and refs ['a','b','ghost'] are checked; Then 2 issues are returned whose messages contain 'b' and 'ghost'

tests.name: new: dangling refs after fallback load
tests.title: reports no issues when every ref resolves to a loaded asset
tests.scenario: Given a manifest with assets 'a' and 'b' where b's file is missing; When loaded with fallback and ref ['a'] is checked; Then no issues are returned

units.title: REQ · Loader valid, invalid and missing-asset fallback paths are proven with fs mocked
REQ · Dangling asset references are reported against a loader-produced manifest with fs mocked
Evidence: Mocked-dependency manifest loader unit tests pass
